item.title: Welcome to Bupa! ❤️
item.description: A new chapter begins! Life has a way of continuing the story even when one chapter comes to an end. Today, I begin a new one at Bupa Group, joining as Head of Engineering at Bupa Capability Centre (BCC), India. And what a warm welcome from the BCC team! Whenever we start something new, we bring assumptions, experiences, and a collection of things we know—and many things we don’t. A new beginning is also an opportunity to pause, learn, unlearn, and look at familiar problems with fresh eyes.

item.title: AI-Assisted Jagjeevan Dose — My ICU Time!
item.description: We often hear that times are changing. In the AI era, change is no longer gradual — it is accelerated. Today, AI agents assist us in writing, thinking, researching, and even making personal decisions. Many of us now do something unimaginable a few years ago: We even confirm what our doctors say… with AI. AI explains reports. AI answers late-night doubts. AI reassures us when anxiety grows. It is that second opinion!
